author: ojiudezue
title: Ask-the-house by text: a deterministic diag menu first; free-text LLM answers wait for the OC eval; WhatsApp accepts self-chat only
summary: The operator wants to query house state and run diagnostics over iMessage/WhatsApp, and asked whether this should be the OC.
why: A deterministic menu cannot invent a diagnosis; the OC agent still fails its eval on diagnosis depth. The query functions are a shared read-only house_status layer that OC can later call as tools, so the menu is not throwaway. The digits 1/2/3 already mean ack/status/silence, so the menu uses windowed numbers with two guards (alert-active check and close-on-send). WhatsApp inbound had been silently dead (wrong payload keys). The bridge runs on the operator's own number, so only self-chat is trusted; otherwise family chats would become commands.
implications: Shipped as a merge to develop (dea1b7e3), deploy pending restart as v5.104.0. iMessage is the live channel; WhatsApp from the operator may stay dark if the bridge never forwards fromMe.
revisit_trigger: The OC eval passes on held-out cases (then enable free text), or the WhatsApp self-chat live check shows no rows.
